items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Dinah Washington, I think they had.

ctx.x: I went with them. And they were strictly colored, you know. Dinah Washington, I think they had. And it didn't do no good. In fact, things started to dropping. And eventually, I got the house band at the Savoy. I had the house band in the Savoy until they closed it down.
Well, Cootie, the Gale Agency wasn't going to give you the house band in the Savoy unless you were back with them, were they?
